text:
anna: Heads-up 1: vendor SI reported a weird perf regression on V100 + ROCm when quantized models hit certain attention kernels. Seems tied to driver >= 540.x and unpinned kernel ABI in marketplace images. Low customer impact but visible in partner labs.
sam: thanks. Do we have a minimal repro or telemetry link? @rolf can you triage?
rolf: repro: small script in perf-lab; reproduces ~8% p95 latency spike on seq64 workloads.
```bash
# repro (perf-lab)
python -m quickbench --model q4_k --seq 64 --device v100 --rocm 5.7 --driver 541.02
```
rolf: log snippet: `failed to allocate attention_scratch, falling back to host memory` then increased tail latency.
infra-test: checking marketplace images now. Found subset of AMIs built without kernel-ABI pin; those correlate with partner sandbox accounts.
partner-ops: marketplace note 1: We can expedite replacement AMIs if you provide test artifacts, SBOM, validation results, and release notes. Also need a contact for partner comms.
sam: I'll coordinate vendor hotfix request and get a build id. ETA 5h for a minimal patched driver blob.
anna: proposed plan:
 1) vendor artifact + smoke validation
 2) rebuild AMIs/container images with kernel-ABI pinned to 538.12 for now
 3) canary deploys in ap-southeast-1 (partner lab)
 4) partner announcement + SI instructions for airgapped installs
 5) update AMI builder to gate on driver/kernel-ABI going forward
rolf: I'll run the canary smoke once the artifact is ready. Test harness:
```bash
./smoke_test --endpoint $CANARY --requests 1500 --seq 64 --compare baseline_rocm_v5.6.json
```
devrel-bot: note: partner-labs:ap-southeast-1 canary scheduled 2026-03-22T21:00:00Z (job id can-9912).
partner-ops: please include a rollback section for SI customers: "If unable to apply patch, revert to driver 538.12 and pin kernel-ABI until further notice."
rolf: quick telemetry scrub 1: affected partner sandboxes showed 4-6% error-rate increase due to timeouts, approximate 3000 requests/day across previews. Low severity but partner-visible.
sam: action owners:
- sam: vendor engagement + artifact (ETA 5h)
- rol f: canary smoke + telemetry (ETA 7h)
- anna: partner comms & SI rollback guide (ETA 6h)
- partner-ops: marketplace approval fast-track (on artifact)
partner-ops: looping in marketplace PM once artifacts land. Also note legal review if joint branding is used.
infra-test: I'll attach SBOM and smoke logs to the approval ticket.
anna: Draft partner message: "We've identified a narrow driver/kernel-ABI interaction affecting some ROCm builds on V100. We're releasing a hotfix and rebuilt AMIs. Customers in air-gapped environments can pin to 538.12 as a temporary mitigation."
sam: agreed. Keep it concise and technical.
devrel-bot: canary completed: no regressions observed in ap-southeast-1 (2026-03-22T22:15:00Z). Report: s3://redwood-canary-reports/can-9912/summary.json
rolf: smoke results show baseline parity for median and p95. Uploading raw latencies and CRC checks.
partner-ops: I'll submit the marketplace approval request now with attached artifacts. Expect approval within standard 24h but will push for expedite.
anna: follow-ups: 1) add driver/kernel-ABI gating to AMI builder 2) add telemetry rule to alert on attention_scratch OOMs 3) include driver pinning guidance in the marketplace onboarding docs.
anna: thanks all. If partners escalate to sales/legal, ping me and I'll coordinate.
